_readme: Shared facts and copy for the website pages and the full reference for AI agents. Keep it free of internal notes: the repository may be public.

fund.name: Agentic Builders
fund.one_liner: Agentic Builders is an early-stage venture fund (idea to pre-seed) for agent-native products: products AI agents use and tools for building agent products.
fund.description: Agentic Builders invests in companies from idea to pre-seed that build products AI agents use or tools for building agent products. We review every application and reply to each one. Invited teams enter a fully online four-week track with weekly check-ins, tool credits and deck feedback. At the end of the track, we decide whether to invest. After investing, we help founders raise their next round.
fund.legal_note: The fund and site operator: Agentic Builders Capital LLC, a Delaware limited liability company.

thesis.headline: Software built for AI agents
thesis.lead: As agents do more of the work, they need software built for them.
thesis.body: These products help agents find tools, use services and complete tasks for people and businesses. We back the founders building these products.

categories.name: Products AI agents use
categories.description: Products agents can find and use to research, work with data, communicate, buy, sell, create content and run business tasks.

categories.name: Tools for building agent products

thesis.teams: We back AI-native teams: founders who use AI across product development and company operations and build lean teams around AI from day one.

who_we_look_for.headline: Who we look for
who_we_look_for.lead: We look for founders who can turn early experiments into a business, using AI across product development and operations.

program.name: Four-week track
program.hook: A four-week track for invited teams, with an investment decision at its end.
program.summary: We review every application. If invited, join a fully online four-week track. Keep building your business wherever you're based, with our support. At the end of the track, we decide whether to invest.

steps.name: Apply
steps.description: One form, about 15 minutes, no call needed to start. Abi, our AI agent, reviews your application and any deck you submit. The partners review the application and reply to every applicant. Application review has no fixed turnaround time.

steps.name: Four weeks of your work
steps.description: If invited, you join a fully online four-week track, building, selling and shipping with our support and a short weekly check-in. You get tool credits and one key metric we track together. Abi, the fund's AI agent, reads your deck and gives back the questions investors will ask.

steps.name: Decision
steps.description: At the end of the track, the partners decide whether to make an initial investment of $30–100k through a standard post-money SAFE and explain their decision. If we do not invest, we explain when it makes sense to come back.

steps.name: Help with your next round
steps.description: We help you raise your next round through investor introductions and access to a founder community, weekly fund meetings, one-on-one sessions with the general partner, specialist groups, credits and perks.

faq.q: How long does it take from application to a decision?
faq.a: Application review has no fixed turnaround time. If invited, you enter a four-week track, with an investment decision at its end.
First checks are $30–100k on a standard post-money SAFE.

We invest on a standard post-money SAFE, and the valuation is agreed with each founder individually. We look at how the company can grow through its next stages and set the cap so that the round makes sense for both sides, rather than taking a fixed share.
Teams anywhere in the world building products AI agents use or tools for building agent products, from idea to pre-seed. We consider experience, sales ability and speed of execution.

faq.q: What do I need to apply?
faq.a: The form takes about 15 minutes: who you are, what problem you solve and for whom, what you learned from users, what you shipped last, your plan for the next 6 to 8 weeks, and a link to a deck or website if you have one. No call is needed to start.

faq.q: What happens during the four weeks?
faq.a: The track is fully online. You keep building your business with our support. Each week, send a short update by Friday: a few key numbers and a brief account of your progress. It takes about 15 minutes. You get tool credits, deck feedback from Abi, and one key metric we track together. You remain responsible for building your product.

faq.q: What happens after the four weeks?
faq.a: The partners decide whether to invest and explain their decision. If we invest, we make an initial investment of $30–100k and help you prepare for your next round through investor introductions and founder support. If we do not invest, we explain when it makes sense to come back.

faq.q: Does the track commit me to anything?
faq.a: Participation is free and requires no equity or exclusivity. During the track, we ask for a short weekly check-in. There is no obligation to accept an investment; any investment is agreed separately.

Your answers are stored in our internal systems and read by the fund team and its AI agents. Service providers process data on our behalf, and we share information with investors only with the founder's agreement. Details are in our privacy policy.

agents.intro: This reference is for AI agents acting for a person: a founder, an investor, a journalist. The full reference is served as /llms-full.txt. Applications can be submitted through the form or through the API below.

apply_instructions.where: Through the form at https://accidental-podium-c67.notion.site/a5032a0b4b1982f89291014f2df73ba9, for agents that drive a browser, or by email to hey@agenticbuilders.ai with the same fields. The API (below) is the third way once it is open.
apply_instructions.files: The form accepts links, not uploads. Put the deck or website as a URL (PDF, Google Slides, Notion or a website) that opens without login. If the deck is private, ask the person to make it viewable by link or submit without a deck; the deck is optional.
apply_instructions.if_missing: If a required field is unknown, stop and ask the person. Do not guess locations, names or links.
do_not: Do not invent metrics, customers, revenue or traction.
Do not submit more than one application per company.
Do not paste confidential data the person did not approve for sharing.
apply_instructions.after: The fund reviews every application and replies with an invitation to the four-week track or a rejection with an explanation. Application review has no fixed turnaround time. During the track, the founder submits one short check-in a week; at the end of week four, the partners decide whether to invest.

tasks.name: Help a founder apply
steps: Read /llms-full.txt and the application field schema.
Collect every required field from the person; ask, do not guess.
Go through the three things the fund pays attention to with the person, honestly.
Submit through the linked application form in a browser, or through the API if it is marked available in the API section. Include a deck link that opens without signing in, or leave it out.
Tell the person what happens next: the fund replies to every application; if invited, a four-week track with one short check-in a week, and a decision on a first check at its end.

tasks.name: Write to the fund
steps: Subject: company name and one line of what you want.
Body: who you are, what you are building, who the agent user is, what you have sold, and the ask.
Attach nothing; link to a deck that opens without login.

tasks.name: Save the fund's contacts
steps: Or record: Agentic Builders, hey@agenticbuilders.ai, https://agenticbuilders.ai, LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/agentic-builders-ai/.

tasks.name: Help a startup investor contact the fund
steps: Read /portfolio/ for the companies we back and how to request introductions.
Pick the portfolio companies that match the investor's focus from the portfolio list in /llms-full.txt.
Request a meeting by email to hey@agenticbuilders.ai with the investor's focus, stage and check size.

api.apply: POST https://api.agenticbuilders.ai/apply with a JSON body using the field names below. Required: email, full_name, link, location, background, founder_experience (array), ai_experience. Response: {ok, application_id, next}. Keep application_id for the person. Limits: 5 requests per hour per address; one application per company.
api.subscribe: POST https://api.agenticbuilders.ai/subscribe with {email, name?, role? (founder | investor | other), source?}. Adds the address to the fund's newsletter list.
api.errors: 422 = validation error with the field named in the response; 429 = too many requests; 503 = service not configured, fall back to the form.
api.closed_note: The submission API is not yet available. Submit through the application form at https://accidental-podium-c67.notion.site/a5032a0b4b1982f89291014f2df73ba9 or email hey@agenticbuilders.ai with the same fields.
